style: Dark premium results/analytics dashboard card. Same visual system as sibling pieces pricing-tiers-reveal and revenue-math-reveal: near-black bg, gold numerals on a KPI tile, restrained Montserrat labels, League Gothic display numerals. Motion is additive/accumulating (no scene hard-cuts) — header locks in, then two KPI tiles build in staggered, then a closing caption lands under both. Nothing ever replaces or hides prior content, so there is no blank-frame risk.
block: mk-progress-stat (pattern reference only, hand-authored dual-tile dashboard layout — no single-value block covers a two-metric side-by-side KPI dashboard)

customize.note: Reuse the proven tier-card / stat-card CSS chassis + count-up-via-proxy pattern from pricing-tiers-reveal and revenue-math-reveal (same palette tokens, same fromTo count-up idiom). Hand-author two KPI tiles instead of the single-card block since the catalog has no dual-tile dashboard block (checked via `hyperframes catalog --query "dashboard KPI card"` and `"dual stat tiles side by side"` — closest hits were single-card `mk-progress-stat` and `apple-money-count`).

shot_brief: An 11.5s dashboard-style results reveal for a mid-video payoff beat. A quiet eyebrow label locks in top-center ('ORGANIC SEO PAYOFF' / 'ONCE MOMENTUM BUILDS'), then two KPI tiles build in beneath it, staggered left-then-right, each with a line-icon, a gold count-up numeral formatted as a range ('40-60', '28-30'), and a label. Once both tiles have landed side by side as a clean two-tile dashboard, a connecting caption fades in beneath: 'JUST FROM SEO MOMENTUM.' The whole piece freeze-holds for a clean cut back to host footage. Motion is purely additive — nothing is ever removed or hidden after it appears — so the transparent alpha-overlay export never shows a blank frame at any point in the timeline. The single dominant motif is the staggered dual-KPI build; pattern-interrupt is the caption landing as a settle beat after the two-tile reveal.
